notes.title: Pre-Order Daemon X Machina: Titanic Scion & Prepare for War in New Trailer
notes.content:
"How many have sacrificed their lives in pursuit of a sliver of happiness?" 


Debuting at IGN Live, the all-new story trailer for Daemon X Machina: Titanic Scion sets up an epic battle between humans, Outers, and Immortals that’s rife with action and intrigue. Get a glimpse at the cast of characters you’ll side with and fight against. Feel the pulse of the soundtrack backing epic battles between Arsenals, clashing over the fate of humanity. 

The battle ignites on September 5!


[previewyoutube="1PBUqSBwyWE;full"][/previewyoutube]


On top of that new trailer, we’ve also started pre-orders for Daemon X Machina: Titanic Scion! This action-packed new entry in the Daemon X Machina series will be available in a standard edition for $69.99.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1342490/Daemon_X_Machina_Titanic_Scion/"][/dynamiclink]

A Digital Deluxe Edition, which includes the game and access to substantial post-launch DLC, featuring new story content and customization options for your Arsenal and Outer, for $89.99.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/sub/1329421/"][/dynamiclink]

Or a Super Digital Deluxe Edition which includes the game, the aforementioned DLC sets, a digital soundtrack, and a digital art book, for $99.99. 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/sub/1329422/"][/dynamiclink]

All digital pre-orders will get the “Special Equipment Set” DLC as a bonus, which includes the “Bahamut” Arsenal Skin, the Beguiling Suit (Outer Suit), and the Special Equipment – Victorious Gleam (Laser Blade), as well as the “Purchase Bonus Item Set” DLC, which includes the Special Equipment – Variable Breadth (Longbow), Bonus Attachment Set 1, and Bonus Item Set.
